text: - when an order is placed there are *Order Pre-Approve* validations automatically run and if all of these pass the order will be approved automatically (including authorized payments which means that if a payment method or instrument is chosen that can't be authorized you will always get a Pre-Approve warning)
limitation: Read-only screen/dialog evidence only. Prerequisite creation, field input, submissions, integrations and full story transitions are not executed.
